title: 3 key details about what Mark Zuckerberg's vision of the AI future would look like for you
excerpt: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg says personal AI agents could reshape work, help launch smaller companies, and make entrepreneurship more accessible.
content_html:
By Thibault Spirlet

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

Mark Zuckerberg says the future should come with a personal AI agent that knows you, works for you, and never clocks out.

In a 6,500-word blog post published Monday, the Meta CEO laid out his case for "personal superintelligence," which centers on advanced AI distributed to individuals, rather than controlled by a small group of companies, governments, or institutions.

The post, titled "The Future is for Everyone," is Zuckerberg's latest effort to make the positive case for AI amid fears about job displacement, safety, and concentrated power. The CEO has been on a media blitz recently, including a July Wall Street Journal op-ed also titled "The AI Future Is for Everyone."

Separately on Monday, Meta launched Muse Glimmer, an AI model that can be downloaded and run on a consumer laptop. Meta shares were up about 2% in morning trading.

Here are three things to know about Zuckerberg's vision for an AI future.

1. Personal AI agents working 24/7

Zuckerberg imagines everyone having "an exceptionally capable personal agent" that understands their goals, interests, and personal information.

The agent could help manage relationships, health, career choices, finances, household tasks, and hobbies, he wrote. It would free up time and help users accomplish more, and be accessible through devices such as smart glasses (which Meta sells).

Zuckerberg said his own agent flags useful information, helps him prototype ideas, tracks his sleep and training, and plans baking projects with his daughter, including ordering ingredients.

He made a similar pitch for "personal superintelligence" around this time last year.

2. There may be fewer traditional jobs, but more small businesses

Zuckerberg did not dismiss concerns that AI could disrupt the labor market.

He expects company sizes to "shrink" as small teams equipped with powerful AI agents can run businesses at a significant scale. While that could mean smaller companies, it could create more of them, he said.

Still, he predicted AI won't necessarily lead to fewer jobs, as people use the technology to create new businesses and services.

"Many ideas that would have been too hard or expensive to try before will now be possible," he wrote.

He said that a less rosy outcome is possible if automation moves faster than people can develop new skills. His proposed solution: give people personal AI agents that can help them learn and adapt.

Zuckerberg pointed to the jobs that have emerged in recent decades, from app developers to EV technicians, and predicted new roles, including one-person product studios and "world builders" who create games and experiences.

3. Becoming an entrepreneur could get much easier

Zuckerberg's clearest economic prediction is that AI will lower the barriers to entrepreneurship.

He said people are starting to turn ideas into products without raising money or building large teams.

AI could take on tasks that would otherwise require specialized staff or outside contractors, making more ideas viable businesses.

That, he said, would produce a more entrepreneurial economy, where small businesses can have a much larger impact.

His vision depends on access. Meta says it will offer free versions of its AI tools to billions of people, while offering paid access to greater computing power. Zuckerberg also said Meta plans to release more open models soon.

"For everyone to be part of the future, everyone must have the ability to use superintelligence to improve their lives and shape the world," he wrote.

作者：Thibault Spirlet 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

马克·扎克伯格表示，未来应该有一个了解你、为你工作、永远不会下班的个人人工智能代理。

在周一发表的一篇 6,500 字的博客文章中，这位 Meta 首席执行官阐述了他的“个人超级智能”观点，该观点的核心是分配给个人的先进人工智能，而不是由一小群公司、政府或机构控制。

这篇题为“未来属于每个人”的帖子是扎克伯格在人们担心工作岗位流失、安全和权力集中的情况下为人工智能做出积极努力的最新努力。 这位首席执行官最近受到了媒体的热捧，其中包括《华尔街日报》七月发表的一篇题​​为“人工智能的未来属于每个人”的专栏文章。

周一，Meta 还单独推出了 Muse Glimmer，这是一种可以在消费笔记本电脑上下载和运行的人工智能模型。 Meta 股价早盘上涨约 2%。

关于扎克伯格对人工智能未来的愿景，您需要了解以下三件事。

1. 个人人工智能代理 24/7 工作

扎克伯格想象每个人都有一个“非常有能力的个人代理人”，了解他们的目标、兴趣和个人信息。

他写道，该代理人可以帮助管理人际关系、健康、职业选择、财务、家务和爱好。 它将释放时间并帮助用户完成更多任务，并且可以通过智能眼镜（Meta 销售）等设备进行访问。

扎克伯格说，他自己的经纪人会标记有用的信息，帮助他制作创意原型，跟踪他的睡眠和训练情况，并与女儿一起计划烘焙项目，包括订购原料。

去年这个时候，他也曾提出过类似的“个人超级智能”主张。

2. 传统工作可能会减少，但小企业会增加

扎克伯格并没有否认人工智能可能扰乱劳动力市场的担忧。

他预计公司规模将“缩小”，因为配备强大人工智能代理的小团队可以大规模运营业务。 他说，虽然这可能意味着规模较小的公司，但也可能会创建更多的公司。

不过，他预测人工智能不一定会导致就业机会减少，因为人们使用该技术来创造新的业务和服务。

他写道：“许多以前太难或太昂贵而无法尝试的想法现在都成为可能。”

他表示，如果自动化的发展速度快于人们开发新技能的速度，那么结果可能就不那么乐观了。 他提出的解决方案是：为人们提供个人人工智能代理，帮助他们学习和适应。

扎克伯格指出了近几十年来出现的工作岗位，从应用程序开发人员到电动汽车技术人员，并预测了新的角色，包括单人产品工作室和创造游戏和体验的“世界建设者”。

3. 成为一名企业家可能会变得更容易

扎克伯格最明确的经济预测是人工智能将降低创业门槛。

他说，人们开始将想法转化为产品，而无需筹集资金或建立大型团队。

人工智能可以承担原本需要专业人员或外部承包商的任务，使更多的想法成为可行的企业。

他说，这将产生更具创业精神的经济，小企业可以产生更大的影响。

他的愿景取决于访问权限。 Meta 表示，它将向数十亿人提供免费版本的人工智能工具，同时提供对更强大计算能力的付费访问。 扎克伯格还表示，Meta 计划很快发布更多开放模型。

他写道：“为了让每个人都成为未来的一部分，每个人都必须有能力利用超级智能来改善他们的生活并塑造世界。”
